tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

Les théorèmes qui supposent un pas `ok` de ces opérations (`enter_preserves`, `store_preserves*`, `transfer_preserves*`, `exit_preserves*`, `issueAt_preserves`, `arena_inv_preserved`…) valent pour moins de pas, comme G1, G2 et G4 l'imposent. Voir (o).
- **`storeEff`** met `Init` sur la feuille `p` seule ; sur un pas `ok`, `p` est une feuille et l'effet est celui de la passe 6.
- **`Reachable`** prend les opérations restreintes : il atteint moins d'états (`cp1`, `co1`, `fa8`, `transferEff lb5 5 0`).

Aucune hypothèse n'est ajoutée à un énoncé de la passe 6, hormis le changement d'hypothèse de `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer`, dont l'énoncé ancien est conservé.

## (j) Transfert, fin d'usage et allocation des valeurs composites

La description de la passe 6 ((j)) vaut, avec ces changements.

- **`store a p`** écrit dans une feuille `p` libre, la seule à passer à `Init` ; `p` doit rester exerçable en `Modify` après le pas (G2). Écrire une référence dans une structure se fait champ par champ : la structure entière est refusée (`store_field_length_uninit`).
----

La liste de la passe 6, (n) 3, vaut, avec ce changement : `store` écrit une seule feuille, celle d'une référence (G2). G1 écarte de ce jalon toute conséquence sur `noalias` ; le jalon 2 et la traduction bas niveau devront la traiter.

### 4. Ce qui reste hors périmètre

Inchangé (passe 6, (n) 4). La tâche y ajoute `noalias` et la traduction bas niveau, et l'obligation de libération.

La conclusion est inchangée. |

## (p) Verdicts qui changent par rapport à la passe 6

Tous les autres verdicts des passes 1 à 6 sont inchangés : le build rejoue chaque `example` et chaque théorème de cas.

| Cas | Pas | Passe 6 | Passe 7 | Cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cp0` (paramètre et son descendant) | `enterFrame [1, 2] []` | `ok` | `reject` | G1 : 1, origine directe du paramètre `Modify` 2, est un paramètre, donc exerçable dans l'état d'arrivée |
| `co0` (racine possédée) | `enterFrame [2, 3] []` | `ok` | `reject` | G1 : la racine 1, origine du paramètre `Modify` 2, détenue par la place 0, est exerçable par le paramètre 3, qui a `Modify` effectif sur 0 |
| `fa7` (F7 (a)) | `store 8 6` | `ok` | `reject` | G2, clause d'arrivée seule : après le pas, B ne serait couvert que par 7, détenue par A, et A que par 8, détenue par B ; aucun cadre n'aurait `Modify` exerçable sur B |

`example` retirés avec ces changements (5) :
- `TransferStep K0 5 0 lb5 (.ok (transferEff lb5 5 0))` : le verdict est maintenant `reject`, énoncé par `lb5_reachable` et `lb5_escape_rejected` ;

Aucun pas rejeté en passe 6 n'est accepté en passe 7, et aucun `fail` ne devient `reject` : les préconditions ne font que gagner des clauses, et la condition G4 de `issue` ne s'ajoute qu'à l'issue `ok` ((c) 14). Avant la revue, G4 était une clause statique de `issue`, et une émission vers une région indisponible passait de `fail` à `reject` (constat 11) ; ce n'est plus le cas (`callee_issue_unavailable_fails`).

/-- Invariants of the reached states (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): `WF3`, `Inv3`, arena entries
naming existing authorities (`ArenasWF`) and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_invariants {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s := by
  have mk : ∀ {s s' : S3}, KStep k s s' → WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' → AnchorOrder s' → NoDangling s' →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' :=
    fun hk ih h a d => ⟨h.1, ⟨h.2, a, d⟩,
      kstep_preserves_arenas ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hk⟩
  induction h with
  | init hsh =>
    exact ⟨(init_wf statics hsh).1, (init_wf statics hsh).2, fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h,
      fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h⟩
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.derive hs) ih (derive_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (derive_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (derive_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | split _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.split hs) ih (split_preserves_underDD hdd ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (split_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (split_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | release _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.release hs) ih (release_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (release_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (release_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | transfer _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.transfer hs) ih (transfer_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (transfer_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (transfer_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | depend _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.depend hs) ih (depend_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (depend_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (depend_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | enter _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.enter hs) ih (enter_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (enter_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (enter_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | exit _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.exit hs) ih (exit_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (exit_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (exit_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | read _ hs ih => rw [read3_preserves hs]; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.write (k := k) hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (write3_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs) (write3_preserves_anchorOrder _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (write3_preserves_noDangling _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.writeShared hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (writeShared_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (write3_preserves_anchorOrder _ ih.2.1.ao) (write3_preserves_noDangling _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | pin _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.pin (k := k) hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (pinEff_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base) (pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder _ _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (pinEff_preserves_noDangling _ _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | unpin _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.unpin hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (pinEff_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base) (pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder _ _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (pinEff_preserves_noDangling _ _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | endUse _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.endUse hs) ih (endUse_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (endUse_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs)
      (endUse_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | free _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.free hs) ih (free_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs) (free_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs)
      (free_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | alloc _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.alloc hs) ih (alloc_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (alloc_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (alloc_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | newArena _ hs ih => exact newArena_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hs
  | issue _ hs ih => exact issueAt_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hs
  | reset _ hs ih => exact resetAt_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hs
  | store _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.store hs) ih (store_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (store_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (store_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)

/-- `reachable_access_invariant` (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): every reached state satisfies `WF3`,
`Inv3`, and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Conditional on the obligation `DDSound k` of
`DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_access_invariant_underDD {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar :=
  let h' := reachable_invariants hdd h
  ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1, h'.2.2.2⟩

/-- `reachable_no_dangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §10; D3): in every reached state, no active authority
covers a leaf of a place that is not usable. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_no_dangling {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    NoDangling s :=
  (reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h).2.1.nd

/-- `live_arena_storage_usable` (F2): in every reached state, the storage of a live arena is
usable. A corollary of `NoDangling` (C2): `internal` is active and covers the footprint of the
storage (`ArenaInv`, F1), which has a leaf. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem live_arena_storage_usable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → s.Usable ar.storage := by
  obtain ⟨hwf, hinv, hai⟩ := reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h
  intro ar har ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  have hi := hai ar har ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hwf (s.P.length + 1) ar.storage (by omega)
    hi.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by
    have := (hi.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 l).2 hl
    simpa [S3.afp, hy] using this
  exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => hinv.nd ar.internal y hy ya ar.storage hu l hl hly

/-- `RootLive` on the reached states (G3; auxiliary invariant): every usable root place keeps an
active root authority held by its owner. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_rootLive {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : RootLive s := by
  induction h with
  | init _ => exact init_rootLive _
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | split _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | release _ hs ih => exact release_rootLive ih hs
  | transfer hr hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact transfer_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 hpre.1 ih
  | depend _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | enter hr hs ih => exact enter_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | exit _ hs ih => exact exit_rootLive ih hs
  | read _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | pin _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | unpin _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | endUse _ hs ih => exact endUse_rootLive ih hs
  | free _ hs ih => exact free_rootLive ih hs
  | alloc hr hs ih => exact alloc_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | newArena _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | issue _ hs ih =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      cases hst with
      | ok => exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | reset _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split
    · exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
    · exact ih
  | store _ hs ih => exact store_rootLive ih hs

/-- `reachable_no_orphan` (G3): in every reached state, every active authority held by a place is
linked to a frame of the stack by a finite chain of holders without repetition (`NoOrphan`).
Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_no_orphan {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : NoOrphan s :=
  noOrphan_of_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd h).1 (reachable_rootLive hdd h)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` on the reached states (G4): for every usable place and every active authority
it holds, the frame of the effective anchor is the frame of the place or one of its ancestors.
`transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` and the exit check it in their arrival state; the other
operations preserve it. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : AnchorOrderHeld s := by
  induction h with
  | init _ =>
    intro q hq x y hx _ hh
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := init_get hx
    exact effAnchorOK_root_held hx rfl hh hq
  | derive _ hs ih => exact derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | split _ hs ih => exact split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | release _ hs ih => exact release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | transfer _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  | depend _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | enter _ hs ih => obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2
  | exit _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold ExitPre at hpre; split at hpre
    · exact hpre.2.2.2.2
    · exact hpre.elim
  | read _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | pin _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | unpin _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | endUse _ hs ih => exact endUse_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | free _ hs ih => exact free_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | alloc hr hs ih => exact alloc_preserves_anchorOrderHeld (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | newArena _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | issue _ hs ih =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      cases hst with
      | ok _ _ _ h4 => exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld h4 rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | reset _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split
    · exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
    · exact ih
  | store _ hs ih => obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2

/-- The invariant of the reached states extended by G3 and G4 (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3, G3, G4):
`WF3`, `Inv3`, `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (`AnchorOrderHeld`), `NoOrphan`, and
`ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_access_invariant_ext {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s ∧
      ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar :=
  let h' := reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h
  ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1, reachable_anchorOrderHeld hdd h, reachable_no_orphan hdd h, h'.2.2⟩

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` on reached states (MM-03.3 §4, O7; §10), under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling_reachable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {f : Nat}
    {F₀ : Frames} (hs : Reachable k statics s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, OwnedByFrame s.P f q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y →
      y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint :=
  exitFrame_no_dangling (reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd hs).1 hF h

/-- `call_protects_params_safe` as stated by F6 and kept by G1, transitive form, as a predicate on a
state: for a stack `G ++ f :: F₀`, the current frame being `f` or a frame called by `f`
transitively, every authority exercisable by the current frame (A2, B2) that covers a leaf of the
footprint of a `Modify` authority of `callParams f` is that authority or one of its descendants,
whether the parameter is active or not. It concerns the safe accesses of the kernel only: neither
raw pointers nor suspension are represented, and no consequence on `noalias` is drawn here (G1:
milestone 2 and the low-level translation). -/
def CallProtects (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : Frames) (f : Nat) (F₀ : Frames), s.F = G ++ f :: F₀ →
    ∀ p ∈ s.callParams f, ∀ y : Authority, s.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify →
      ∀ (b : Nat) (m : Mode), s.ExercisableAt b m → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ s.afp b →
        b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b

/-- The direct form of `CallProtects` (F6): the current frame is `f`. -/
def CallProtectsDirect (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat) (F₀ : Frames), s.F = f :: F₀ →
    ∀ p ∈ s.callParams f, ∀ y : Authority, s.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify →
      ∀ (b : Nat) (m : Mode), s.ExercisableAt b m → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ s.afp b →
        b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b

theorem CallProtects.direct {s : S3} (h : CallProtects s) : CallProtectsDirect s :=
  fun f F₀ hF => h [] f F₀ hF

theorem S3.ExercisableAt.lt {s : S3} {b : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt b m) :
    b < s.A.length := by
  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›

/-- The condition of `CallProtects` for one parameter `p`, read on the authorities of `A` and on
both modes: decidable form. -/
def ParamProtected (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  (s.A[p]?).map (·.mode) = some .modify →

/-- The pass-6 counterexample to F6 where the caller passes an authority and one of its
descendants, now rejected at `enterFrame` by G1. Frame 1: local 0, of root 0; the caller derives 1,
`Modify` on 0, then 2, `Modify` on 0 from 1, and calls with `[1, 2]`: in the state where the new
frame holds its parameters, the parameter 1, origin of the parameter 2, is exercisable, so the
call is rejected (G1). The state `cp1` the call would produce, no longer reached, still violates
`CallProtects`: there, the parameter 1 is exercisable, covers the leaf 0 of the parameter 2, and is
its ancestor; after the callee releases 2, it writes the leaf 0 through 1. -/
def cp0 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) 1 0 .modify
def cp1 : S3 := enterEff cp0 [1, 2] []
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_param :
    Reachable K0 [] cp0 ∧ EnterStep [1, 2] [] cp0 .reject ∧ ¬ CallProtects cp1 ∧
      ReleaseStep 2 cp1 (.ok (releaseEff cp1 2)) ∧ ¬ CallProtects (releaseEff cp1 2) ∧
      Write3Step 1 [0] (releaseEff cp1 2) (.ok (write3Eff (releaseEff cp1 2) [0])) := by
  have hr : Reachable K0 [] cp0 := .derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have key : ∀ s : S3, s.F = [2, 1, 0] → s.callParams 2 = [1, 2] → s.ExercisableAt 1 .modify →
      (s.A[2]?).map (fun y => (y.mode, y.footprint)) = some (.modify, [0]) → s.afp 1 = [0] →
      s.ancs 1 = [0] → ¬ CallProtects s := by
    intro s hF hc hex h2 h1 ha h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h2
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at e
    have := h.direct 2 [1, 0] hF 2 (by rw [hc]; decide) y hy e.1 1 .modify hex 0 (by rw [e.2]; decide)
      (by rw [h1]; decide)
    rw [ha] at this; simp at this
  exact ⟨hr, .reject (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- The pass-6 counterexample to F6 through owned storage (A5; A2, held authorities), now
rejected at `enterFrame` by G1. Frame 1: value 0, of root 0 held by frame 1, which owns the storage
1, of root 1 held by the place 0. The caller derives 2, `Modify` on 1 from the root 1, and 3,
`Modify` on 0, and calls with `[2, 3]`: in the state where the new frame holds its parameters, the
root 1, origin of the parameter 2, is exercisable through the parameter 3, so the call is
rejected (G1). The state `co1` the call would produce, no longer reached, still violates
`CallProtects`; after the callee releases 2, it writes the leaf 1 through the root 1. -/
def co0 : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0)]) 1 1 .modify) 0 0 .modify
def co1 : S3 := enterEff co0 [2, 3] []
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_owned :
    Reachable K0 [] co0 ∧ EnterStep [2, 3] [] co0 .reject ∧ ¬ CallProtects co1 ∧
      ReleaseStep 2 co1 (.ok (releaseEff co1 2)) ∧ ¬ CallProtects (releaseEff co1 2) ∧
      Write3Step 1 [1] (releaseEff co1 2) (.ok (write3Eff (releaseEff co1 2) [1])) := by
  have hr : Reachable K0 [] co0 := .derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have key : ∀ s : S3, s.F = [2, 1, 0] → s.callParams 2 = [2, 3] → s.ExercisableAt 1 .modify →
      (s.A[2]?).map (fun y => (y.mode, y.footprint)) = some (.modify, [1]) → s.afp 1 = [1] →
      s.ancs 1 = [] → ¬ CallProtects s := by
    intro s hF hc hex h2 h1 ha h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h2
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at e
    have := h.direct 2 [1, 0] hF 2 (by rw [hc]; decide) y hy e.1 1 .modify hex 1 (by rw [e.2]; decide)
      (by rw [h1]; decide)
    rw [ha] at this; simp at this
  exact ⟨hr, .reject (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- Consecutive elements of a list related by `R`. -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (G3): every active authority held by a place is linked to a frame of the stack by a
finite chain of holders without repetition: the chain starts with an active authority held by a
frame of the stack, ends with the authority, and each link is an active authority that covers the
place holding the next link (`CoversHolder`). -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

theorem linked_cons {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {a : Nat} {l : List Nat} :
    Linked R (a :: l) ↔ (∀ b, l.head? = some b → R a b) ∧ Linked R l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [Linked]
  | cons b l => simp [Linked]

theorem linked_dropWhile {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {p : Nat → Bool} :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, Linked R l → Linked R (l.dropWhile p)
  | [], h => h
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    exact ⟨hl.1, this⟩

/-! ### Root authorities of usable places -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant for G3: every usable root place has an active authority without origin,
held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the place (A4; B1). -/
def RootLive (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), s.A[i]? = some z ∧
    z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧
    ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

theorem WF3.parent_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {i o : Nat} (h : parentOf s.P i = some o) :
    o < i ∧ o < s.P.length := by
  simp only [parentOf] at h

  | none => rw [hp] at h; cases h

    rw [hp] at h

    exact ⟨hlt, lt_of_getElem? hpr⟩

structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  freed : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool
  arenas : List Arena
  callParams : Nat → List Nat

/-- Contracts `K` (MM-03.3.8) for an execution. Types are a representation choice: regions as
lists of leaves; `SharedMutable`, `Pinned` and `ExternalDone` on leaves; `Deallocable p` and
`FreeCompat p auth` for `free` (A6); `Satisfiable provider shape s` for `alloc` (B5; C9: it
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (C4): the holder is the current frame, or a place on
which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HasRight`, B2). -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
